OFFER DATE 6/10 at noon. An exceptional urban retreat in the heart of NOPA. This beautifully updated residence offers a perfect blend of grand-scale living & thoughtful design. Soaring 11+ foot ceilings & expansive windows illuminate the open floor plan.

The chefs kitchen features rich cherry wood cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a center island with an eat-in counter, a dedicated wine fridge, & a spacious walk-in pantry complete with laundry facilities. The living & separate dining areas flow seamlessly into a versatile office space, perfect for todays lifestyle.

A cozy gas fireplace, & a beautifully restored claw foot tub offering a touch of vintage charm, cleverly integrated overhead storage units, comprehensive wiring for speakers & networking, a remote entry callbox, a remote video security system, & owned solar panels. A private balcony & shared patio extend your living space outdoors, offering rare urban retreats.

You're moments from iconic green spaces like Alamo Square, Buena Vista, & Duboce Park. The area is a culinary delight, conveniently near renowned establishments such as Nopa, Che Fico, Beretta, Bar Crudo, Souvla, Wine Kitchen, Brenda's, Horsefeather.& Falletti Foods. Muni lines 5, 6, 7, 21, 22, 24, 43, & the N-Judah
